senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. זוּעֵ, a. נָדָה, נְדֵי II)to move, shake; to drip.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:3">Yoma V, 3</cite> <he>וה׳ ממנו וכ׳</he> and sprinkled from it once upward &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא היה מתכוין להַזּוֹת</he> and he did not aim at definite points in sprinkling.
<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 8:12">Tosef. Toh. VIII, 12</cite> <he>שבא להזות</he> who comes asking to be sprinkled upon; <he>אין מַזִּין עליו וכ׳</he> we do not sprinkle upon him &c.
Par. XII, 8 לא יַזֶּה וכ׳ he must not sprinkle upon the spindle and the whorl separately; a. fr.—Trnsf. to have a cleansing influence.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:14">Tosef. Dem. I, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:15">Tosef. Makhsh. III, 15</cite> <he>טהור אחד מַוֶּה על וכ׳</he> one clean person has a cleansing influence on one hundred unclean persons; Y. Dem. III, 23ᶜ bot.

senses.gloss: to be sprinkled. Par. l. c. ואם הזה מוּזֶּה but if he has sprinkled (on each separately), it is sprinkled (the lustration is valid).
